## Row format

Add your row at the **end** of the right category's table in `README.md`:

```
| [Product Name](https://product.com) | One-line description of what it does | 💸 ♾️ **60% OFF** lifetime · code `BF26` | Nov 24, 2026 - Dec 1, 2026 |
```

- **Name**: product name linked to the product or deal page
- **Description**: one line, no feature lists
- **Deal details**: discount first, then the coupon code (or "auto-applied" if no code is needed). Start with 💸 if the discount is 50% or more, and ♾️ if it's a lifetime or buy-once deal
- **Start-End date**: `Mon D, YYYY - Mon D, YYYY`, e.g. `Nov 24, 2026 - Dec 1, 2026`

## Checklist

- [ ] Added to the right category, at the end of its table
- [ ] Row has exactly 4 columns
- [ ] Description is one line
- [ ] Deal details start with the discount (plus 💸 / ♾️ if they apply)
- [ ] Dates follow the `Nov 24, 2026 - Dec 1, 2026` format
- [ ] This product isn't already listed
